I found some documentation online and realized my mistake, thank you for your help.

Is the best way to go from the markdown creating in RStudio to PDF via Pandoc? 
I use pandoc -V geometry:paperwidth=8.5in -V geometry:paperheight=11in -V geometry:margin=.7in -o SV.pdf SV.md

LaTeX seems so messy just to create a nice R document.

Thank you for your help, I'm loving Knitr!

of PDF generation. Perhaps one day you will be able to convert R
Markdown to PDF with a single click in RStudio... We talked about this
possibility but it is a big challenge, so no guarantee it will happen
at all.
